headline: Tatyana Kim has stepped down as CEO of Wildberries
summary: Tatyana Kim has left the post of chief executive of Wildberries. Alexei Kulikov, a senior manager on the platform, has been appointed as the new head of the company.
why: Wildberries is one of Russia's largest online marketplaces, so leadership changes there matter for e-commerce investors and suppliers in the Russian market.
original_headline: Татьяна Ким покинула пост генерального директора Wildberries
